column2: Prospectors working the De Kaap valley have uncovered payable gold. A mining settlement is rapidly taking shape around Barberton, drawing diggers, merchants and transport riders into the eastern Transvaal. The field is smaller than the later Witwatersrand, but it is large enough to transform the district and to demonstrate how mineral wealth can overturn the old pastoral economy.

With the trekker settlement at Pietermaritzburg now securely in our hands, the Volksraad can finally conduct the republic from its intended inland capital rather than from the exposed commercial anchorage at Port Natal. Government offices, church life and wagon traffic are beginning to gather around the town.
The Volksraad shall sit at Pietermaritzburg.
